data.name: Khushika
data.gender_notes: Khushika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Khushika is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Khush' meaning joy and happiness. It is a name bestowed upon a child born into a prosperous and contented family or one who brings happiness to others. The name Khushika carries the meaning “Joy, Happiness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Khushika usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, happiness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
